metadata.description: Plugins for working with ymer.ax, layered: the core plugin `ymer` holds the practice every user runs — its phases, kaizen and setup — and a domain plugin specializes it. Using any plugin requires a Ymer Node you run and one folder for your state, any folder, under version control or not; a ymer.ax account is optional, and the default where a session reaches it. Install `ymer` and run `/ymer:setup` to create what is missing and report what it found.

plugins.name: ymer
plugins.description: The directed way of working, as skills you invoke: brainstorm a topic into a direction, scout the ground, define what it means, plan it, harden the plan, implement it, review and ship — plus the supporting moves the phases lean on, kaizen's capture and summary over your working process, and the setup that checks the environment every plugin works from.
